title: Retry helper re-runs validation failures that can never succeed
prompt: withRetry in lib/retry.mjs is meant to retry only transient (RetryableError) failures, but a service outage last week showed it happily re-running validation errors too, and callers count attempts in metrics. Fix the retry condition: a non-retryable error must surface on its first attempt, a retryable one must be attempted exactly 1 + retries times. Verify with your own script (count calls) before answering.
